description: This file defines the ItemConfigure class for managing item configuration dialogs, including attribute selection, range inputs, and cart addition, within an e-commerce portal.

classes.name: ItemConfigure
classes.description: Class for configuring an item with attributes, ranges, and cart integration.

methods.name: show_configure_dialog
methods.description: Displays the configuration dialog with attribute options.

methods.name: on_attribute_selection
methods.description: Handles attribute selection changes and updates valid options.

methods.name: show_range_input_for_all_fields
methods.description: Displays range inputs for all applicable fields.

methods.name: show_range_input_if_applicable
methods.description: Shows range input control if attribute value suggests a range.

methods.name: update_range_values
methods.description: Updates stored range values for attributes.

methods.name: show_remaining_optional_attributes
methods.description: Displays optional attributes that are unselected.

methods.name: set_loading_status
methods.description: Displays loading status in the dialog.

methods.name: set_item_found_status
methods.description: Displays item found status with options.

methods.name: get_html_for_item_found
methods.description: Generates HTML for item found status.

methods.name: btn_add_to_cart
methods.description: Adds selected item to shopping cart.

methods.name: get_next_attribute_and_values
methods.description: Fetches next attribute options based on current selections.

methods.name: get_attributes_and_values
methods.description: Fetches all attribute options for the item.

methods.name: get_cache_key
methods.description: Returns cache key for current item configuration.

methods.name: call
methods.description: Wraps frappe.call in a Promise for async calls.
